text:
Nina P: Aurelia Labs put a hold on payments and escalated — they say this invoice charged both PLATFORM_FEE and PLATFORM_FEE_ADDON for the same private deployment period. Can someone confirm if this is a duplicate charge?
David H: Pulling invoice 2026-AL-3341 now. Quick glance shows two platform-like lines. Might be an addon that should've been consolidated.
Liang M: Invoice snippet:
```
Invoice 2026-AL-3341
Line 10: PLATFORM_FEE_PRIVATE    1 x USD 10,500
Line 11: PLATFORM_FEE_ADDON     1 x USD 10,500
Line 12: DEDICATED_COMMIT       1 x USD 60,000
```
Customer claims addon is legacy billing artifact and should have been suppressed after migration to private-package on 2026-01-01.
BillingBot: Reconciliation run: contract reference AL-CON-2025-C indicates PLATFORM_ADDON deprecated on 2026-01-01 by SOW amendment AL-AM-03. Rule mismatch: billing rule did not apply amendment. Created ticket BILL-4620.
Sergio T: Oof. Our billing transform missed the deprecation flag during SKU mapping. This is a system bug, not a customer change request. We should prioritize a refund + fix.
Nina P: Aurelia's AP wants either immediate refund or we'll lose payment. They flagged SLA implications. Finance preference is proforma credit, but if they're holding payments we may need to issue a cash refund. Thoughts?
Carla G: We need Legal signoff for cash refunds over 5k. Can we quantify the duplicate amount?
David H: Duplicate platform amount = USD 10,500. Net invoice after intended credit would still be positive (they owe remaining commit). But AP is refusing to net; they want a standalone refund transaction.
Liang M: I see two options: (A) Proforma corrected invoice + credit memo to apply to next cycle, or (B) Immediate refund (ACH) and a corrected invoice. Option B requires Rev Ops and Legal approvals, and cash impact today.
Sergio T: Fixing the billing rule will take ~48 hours to deploy. Meanwhile Ops suggests refund to unblock customer.
Carla G: Legal: refund approved for this case due to erroneous duplicate charge. We need an email trail from Aurelia confirming they accept cash refund now and waive any dispute escalation.
Nina P: I have Aurelia on thread: @Aurelia-AP please confirm you accept an immediate ACH refund of USD 10,500 and we'll follow with corrected invoice and credit memo.
Aurelia-AP (external): Confirmed, we will accept ACH refund and will resume payment once refund is processed. Thank you.
BillingBot: Generated refund request RFD-2026-AL-017 for USD 10,500. Pending Rev Ops approval. Ticket BILL-4620 linked.
Carla G: Rev Ops (Ollie) please approve clearing the cash. Also provide GL account to debit.
Sergio T: Rev Ops code: debit 5-EXP-Refunds, credit 1-CASH. Approving refund now. Sergio T (Rev Ops) 2026-03-20 11:03 PT.
David H: Processing ACH now. Payment reference ACH-AL-20260320-77.
BillingBot: Refund RFD-2026-AL-017 executed, tx ref ACH-AL-20260320-77. Credit memo CM-2026-AL-018 created to reconcile systems. Ticket BILL-4620 status: PENDING FIX + REFUNDED.
Liang M: Adding postmortem item: ensure deprecation flag propagation in SKU mapping ETL. I'll open infra bug with eng-billing.
Nina P: Please attach SOW amendment AL-AM-03 and Aurelia confirmation to the ticket. Closing loop: Aurelia will clear remaining balance once ACH posts.
Carla G: Noting legal approval on ticket: Carla G 2026-03-20 11:10 PT.
BillingBot: BILL-4620 updated: RESOLUTION = "issued cash refund + corrected invoice; billing transform queued for fix".
Nina P: Thanks team — marking as resolved on our end after AR confirms payment.
